findings.body: The only test changes are comments; no assertion checks the client-reference cleanup. The existing repository scan in tests/test_no_plugin.py:35 checks plugin references, while tests/test_fix_old_forge_records.py:13 checks record filenames, so restoring the removed client names or paths would pass both. Add a regression check covering tracked docs, records, plans and tests, run it through the repository's existing verification flow, and demonstrate that it fails before this cleanup and passes afterward. This is missing coverage under the requested test audit.

why: Symphony Forge must carry no trace of any client repo, but its docs, records, tests and plans still name client repos and their paths
